shortDescription: Exor EURONEXT:EXO, the investment arm of Italy's billionaire Agnelli family, announced a share buyback of €500 million ($572 million) on Tuesday.The group also reported a first-half net asset value of €157.9 per share, a decrease of 3.9% compared to last year.($1 = 0.8748 euros)
